_doc: Initial production configuration and state for the vacuum-float progress machinery. The production ledger starts EMPTY: no events, no points, no awards, no material cards, no margin, no gap — UNVERIFIED and UNKNOWN, never zeros or inherited values. Copy this file to the owned live location and adjust only what Sciences binds; the ledger directory itself is passed explicitly on every invocation.
_admiral_seats_note: Empty by default: the canonical register of minted Admiral role seats is not machine-readable from this repo. Sciences/Desk populate this list before any rubric change can validate; until then a rubric-change filing stays a nomination with that precise reason.

programme_start._doc: The accepted Sciences execution brief is the programme-start anchor (U3-BRIEF binding 2). Anchor id and its admitted-at timestamp; only an admitted Una-verified map point resets the scientific stall afterwards.

scoring._doc: Scorer conventions (v0) — Una's disposition of 2026-10-17 (sha256 d9c2a6a289b91fb9f5f9acc1750f487d191ba0e80d837dff30d971f1604368ec), carried in research/program/POINTS.md. The capped kinds admit while the lane has fewer than the cap verified in the ROLLING 168 hours ending at the verification instant (UTC, exact instants, no calendar week); over-cap events score 0 and are never banked or rescored.

cost._doc: Cost per VERIFIED map point needs an explicit matching interval and coverage. Until the accounting basis is agreed (ratio_basis UNSET), views show counts and measured cost separately rather than a misleading ratio. Token accounting is session-keyed and cumulative per lane (latest native-record snapshot per session, summed per lane; overhead usage excluded and shown beside cost); crossings pend until Una awards them.
